name: live2d-vrm-animation
description: Make Live2D (Cubism on PixiJS) and VRM (three.js + three-vrm) characters move naturally: load order, procedural pose vs. clip overrides, layering before physics, fixing VTube Studio models, AnimationMixer pitfalls, a procedural follow-through layer, spring bones, and data formats for AI-generated expressions and motions.
